description: This file defines the EditReminderDialog class, a UI component for creating and editing reminders in an Android app. It manages user interactions for setting reminder details, including date and time, and handles notification permissions.

classes.name: EditReminderDialog
classes.description: A dialog class for editing or creating reminders, handling user input for reminder details and managing notification permissions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes noteId and reminder from arguments.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up the dialog UI, populates fields if editing an existing reminder, and requests notification permissions if needed.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Configures date and time pickers and save button behavior.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Static method to create a new instance of EditReminderDialog with specified noteId and reminder.
